article.title: 尼泊爾旅遊局與TikTok以創作者和直播推廣旅遊
article.title_en: Nepal Tourism Board and TikTok use creators and livestreams for destination marketing
article.summary: 11月5日於加德滿都啟動的新一輪活動，透過專題標籤頁、創作者合作及景點直播展示旅遊體驗。
article.summary_en: The November 5 Kathmandu launch uses a hashtag hub, creator collaborations and destination livestreams to showcase travel experiences.
highlights: 本地創作者合作與國際旅遊創作者內容同步展開。
highlights_en: The campaign is scheduled to run through the end of 2026.
Local creator collaborations accompany content from international travel creators.
article.why: 目的地團隊可用同一主題聚合多地內容，同時保留創作者各自的觀眾與敘事角度。
article.why_en: Destination teams can gather content under one theme while keeping creators’ distinct voices and audiences.
article.next_step: 先分配景點與內容格式，再以標籤頁互動及實際查詢評估各段內容。
article.next_step_en: Allocate sites and formats first, then assess hub engagement and travel enquiries separately.
article.detail: 尼泊爾旅遊局6月已與TikTok在同一主題下舉辦短片工作坊。11月的發展是加德滿都啟動活動，以及透過專題標籤頁、創作者合作及景點直播安排內容發佈。Business 360的現場報道交代了活動安排，未有旅遊預訂或到訪數據。旅遊品牌可以分開記錄觀看、行程查詢和預訂，避免把不同階段的反應混算。
article.detail_en: The tourism board and TikTok held a June workshop under the same theme. November adds the Kathmandu launch and a distribution plan built around the hashtag hub, creator collaborations and livestreams. Business 360 reports event arrangements without booking or visitor results. Track views, enquiries and bookings separately.
